title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Southwest Portland corridors in Lewis & Clark College’s practical orbit, each paired with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Tryon Creek State Natural Area
cards.subtitle: S Terwilliger Boulevard — follow a forested bike path
cards.notes: Enter from S Terwilliger Boulevard and use the official trail map to choose a route; the paved bike path continues toward Boones Ferry Road.
cards.short_summary: A mapped state natural area with a three-mile paved cycling route beside Terwilliger Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State Parks lists the site at 11321 S Terwilliger Boulevard and documents a three-mile paved bicycle path along the park’s east edge.
cards.source_title: Tryon Creek State Natural Area - Oregon State Parks
cards.access_notes: Consult the Oregon State Parks profile for current notices and use the linked official trail map before visiting.

cards.title: Marshall Park
cards.subtitle: SW 12th Drive — take the canyon trails to a waterfall
cards.notes: Use the SW 12th Drive entrance for the playground, then follow maintained paths into the canyon; keep dogs leashed throughout the park.
cards.short_summary: A wooded canyon park where trails pass Tryon Creek, a stone bridge, and a small waterfall.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks identifies Marshall Park at 9700 SW 12th Drive and documents hiking trails, a waterfall, Tryon Creek, and a stone bridge.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are currently listed as 5:00am–10:00pm; the closest playground access is on SW 12th Drive.

cards.title: Fulton Park
cards.subtitle: SW Miles Street — bring a ball for the courts or field
cards.notes: Approach from SW Miles Street and choose the basketball court, soccer field, or playground; reserve the sports field through Portland Parks if needed.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood recreation stop combining a playground, basketball court, and soccer field.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks lists Fulton Park at 68 SW Miles Street with a playground, soccer field, basketball court, picnic tables, and unpaved paths.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are currently listed as 5:00am–midnight; sports-field reservations require contacting Portland Parks.

cards.title: Butterfly Park Naturescape
cards.subtitle: S Macadam Avenue — pause for native plants and river views
cards.notes: Enter from the Willamette Moorage parking area on S Macadam Avenue and follow the short unpaved path toward the river and interpretive sign.
cards.short_summary: A compact restored habitat linking Macadam Avenue with the Willamette Greenway Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks places the naturescape at 7720 S Macadam Avenue and documents native grasses, wildflowers, an interpretive sign, paths, and river views.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are currently listed as 5:00am–midnight; access is available from Macadam Avenue or Willamette Park.

cards.title: Willamette Park
cards.subtitle: S Macadam Avenue at Nebraska Street — reach the riverfront trail
cards.notes: Enter at Nebraska Street, then use the paved paths or Willamette Greenway Trail; check parking rules before arriving by car.
cards.short_summary: A broad waterfront park serving cyclists, picnickers, field users, and river watchers.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks locates Willamette Park east of S Macadam Avenue at Nebraska Street and documents waterfront views, paved paths, lawns, courts, and the greenway trail.
cards.access_notes: Current hours are 5:00am–10:00pm, with vehicle access closing at 10:00pm; parking is pay-to-park.

cards.title: Powers Marine Park
cards.subtitle: S Macadam Avenue — walk an unpaved riverfront strip
cards.notes: Look for the entrance south of Sellwood Bridge on S Macadam Avenue, then stay on the unpaved path and keep dogs leashed near the river.
cards.short_summary: A narrow riverside natural area with picnic tables, habitat installations, and Willamette views.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks places Powers Marine Park on S Macadam Avenue south of Sellwood Bridge and documents unpaved paths, picnic tables, and riverfront views.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are currently listed as 5:00am–midnight; all dogs must remain leashed.

cards.title: Multnomah Arts Center
cards.subtitle: SW Capitol Highway — see work in two public galleries
cards.notes: Enter from SW Capitol Highway and check the Front and Center Galleries before registering for a class; gallery visits require no admission.
cards.short_summary: A corridor-side arts complex with rotating regional exhibitions and multidisciplinary classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks lists the center at 7688 SW Capitol Highway and states that its Front and Center Galleries are free to visit.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Monday–Thursday 9:00am–9:30pm and Friday–Saturday 9:00am–5:00pm; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Hillsdale Library
cards.subtitle: SW Sunset Boulevard — use Wi-Fi, computers, and study resources
cards.notes: Visit from SW Sunset Boulevard for Wi-Fi, computers, printing, scanning, or holds; check the construction notice before planning a study session.
cards.short_summary: A full-service neighborhood library on Sunset Boulevard with equipment and community rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Multnomah County Library lists Hillsdale Library at 1525 SW Sunset Boulevard with Wi-Fi, computers, printers, scanners, and community rooms.
cards.access_notes: The library lists August 23, 2026 as its last public day before construction, with reopening planned for December 2026.

cards.title: Terwilliger Parkway
cards.subtitle: SW Terwilliger Boulevard — walk the paved hillside path
cards.notes: Start at a mapped access point and follow the paved pedestrian route beside SW Terwilliger Boulevard; use pullouts only where officially provided.
cards.short_summary: A historic, wooded parkway with a continuous walking route, bike lanes, overlooks, and gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks documents Terwilliger Parkway as a 2.5-mile wooded corridor with a paved pedestrian path, bike lanes, trails, picnic tables, and scenic pullouts.
cards.access_notes: Use the official park page for mapped access and current policies; dogs must remain leashed.

cards.title: George Himes Park
cards.subtitle: SW Terwilliger Boulevard at Slavin Road — hike among native trees
cards.notes: Enter near SW Terwilliger Boulevard and Slavin Road for a hilly forest walk; wear suitable footwear for paved and unpaved sections.
cards.short_summary: A wooded hillside destination with native plants and viewpoints above the river corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Portland Parks identifies George Himes Park at SW Terwilliger Boulevard and Slavin Road and describes forested hiking, native plants, and river and mountain views.
cards.source_title: Common Locations | Field trips, guided walks, custom nature programs
cards.access_notes: The city notes street parking only, hilly terrain, and a combination of paved and unpaved paths.
